about: Our loading screens (LSCR, decision 0012): one per row, the text of that province-wide fact in world/sources/lore/loading-facts.json (text-reviewed 2026-10-31; the lore family is not yet a world table, so the reviewed text is carried here), no 3D model, on the Oblivion-like Loading Menu's paper. Every other loaded LSCR is shelled never-true by intermediate.quarantine_layers.

screens.text: There are few roads in Black Marsh. The principal way to travel is by boat.
The Hist are giant spore trees that grow in the innermost swamps of Black Marsh.
All Hist trees are joined at the root. They share one mind and speak to one another.
Argonian eggs are usually incubated in pools of Hist sap so that the Hist can help with the hatching.
On their Naming Day a hatchling licks the Hist and is granted a name.
A xul-vaat, or grave-stake, pins a corpse into the mud so it does not float up when the marsh floods. The dead person's story is carved upon it.
Change, or 'vastei', is perhaps the strongest driving force behind the Saxhleel. They hold that defying change is folly.
Jel has no past or future tense, only the present. Argonians also express attitude through body movement.
Marsh-born Argonians enjoy wallowing in cool mud and basking in the sun. Wallowing keeps their scales from drying out. They do not worship the sun.
Crocodiles, known locally as rormasu, are common throughout Black Marsh.
Argonians hatch with an egg-tooth. A cracked egg-tooth on a newborn is seen as a good omen.
Teeba-Hatsei, or 'Hip and Tail Ball', is an Argonian sport played with hips, elbows and tails. Hands and feet may not strike the ball.
